transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Before we go further, I want to make sure we're all aligned on the regulatory timeline and the open issues in our draft response. We have 30 calendar days to submit our written response to the deficiency letter, and the draft that's been circulated still has unresolved questions across four areas: software scope, lot disposition, the pediatric indication, and the patient-data fields to be included. We need to reach internal consensus on each of those before we can approve and submit anything. I'd like to hear from each of you on where your teams stand on resolving these open items.

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further. After our technical call with the regulator, I received a written follow-up message from them that I saved in the regulatory mailbox but haven't yet incorporated into the circulated draft. The regulator confirmed two specific constraints: first, that our response must be limited to software version 4.2 only, and second, that it must include an answer matrix with exactly six question rows. This directly affects the software scope question that's currently unresolved in our draft, and it also means we need to structure our response to map cleanly to six regulator questions.
